claims.originating_goal: Bind the My KV Connected Accounts selector to the exact non-secret KV-to-SKAP account metadata packet and canonical InTr profile without exposing provider identifiers or secrets.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release only after exact packet/request/envelope conformance, structured SKAP receipt validation, Site validation, merge evidence, and claim terminalization.
expected_evidence: shared CVK/TVC conformance vector consumed by Site
exact non-secret packet/request/envelope regenerated in browser source
only kv-skap-account-metadata profile accepted for SKAP transfer
raw provider identifiers and credentials rejected
boolean-only accepted response no longer sufficient
exact admitted SKAP account metadata receipt required before success
collision_boundaries: Do not widen device-kv, kv-skap, or kv-skap-custody semantics
Do not expose raw provider account IDs or credentials
Do not claim runtime admission from source or CI
Do not create a second InTr runtime or SKAP vault
